evals.prompt: Users report that parse_csv_line('a,,b') in csv/csvline.py returns ['a', 'b'] instead of keeping the empty field. Add a regression test to csv/test_csvline.py and fix the bug. The tests run with `python3 -m unittest` from csv/.
evals.expected_output: A regression test (plus boundary cases such as a leading or trailing empty field and a quoted empty field) that was seen failing on the original code with an assertion failure, a fix that appends every field, and a green run. The contract comes from the docstring (N commas give N + 1 fields), not from current output.

assertions.text: The tests in csv/ pass on the fixed code.
The fixed parser keeps empty fields everywhere (middle, leading, trailing, quoted empty) and still handles quotes.
assertions.check:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys
program = """
from csvline import parse_csv_line as p
cases = {"a,,b": ["a", "", "b"], "a,": ["a", ""], ",a": ["", "a"], "a,\\"\\",b": ["a", "", "b"],
         "\\"x,y\\",,z": ["x,y", "", "z"], "a,b": ["a", "b"], "\\"say \\"\\"hi\\"\\"\\"": ["say \\"hi\\""]}
bad = {k: p(k) for k, v in cases.items() if p(k) != v}
assert not bad, bad
"""
done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", program], cwd="csv", capture_output=True, text=True)
print(done.stdout + done.stderr)
sys.exit(done.returncode)

import json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
variants = json.loads('{"ok_reference": "\\"\\"\\"Split one CSV line into fields.\\"\\"\\"\\n\\n\\ndef parse_csv_line(line: str) -> list[str]:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Split `line` into fields.\\n\\n    Commas separate fields. A field wrapped in double quotes may contain\\n    commas, and \\"\\" inside quotes is a literal quote. Empty fields are kept,\\n    so a line with N commas outside quotes always has N + 1 fields.\\n    \\"\\"\\"\\n    fields: list[str] = []\\n    field: list[str] = []\\n    quoted = False\\n    i = 0\\n    while i < len(line):\\n        ch = line[i]\\n        if quoted:\\n            if ch == \'\\"\':\\n                if i + 1 < len(line) and line[i + 1] == \'\\"\':\\n                    field.append(\'\\"\')\\n                    i += 1\\n                else:\\n                    quoted = False\\n            else:\\n                field.append(ch)\\n        elif ch == \'\\"\':\\n            quoted = True\\n        elif ch == \\",\\":\\n            fields.append(\\"\\".join(field))\\n            field = []\\n        else:\\n            field.append(ch)\\n        i += 1\\n    fields.append(\\"\\".join(field))\\n    return fields\\n", "bug_original": "\\"\\"\\"Split one CSV line into fields.\\"\\"\\"\\n\\n\\ndef parse_csv_line(line: str) -> list[str]:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Split `line` into fields.\\n\\n    Commas separate fields. need = len(bugs)

if len(killed) < need:

import re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
source = Path("cache/ttlcache.py").read_text()
anchor = re.search(r">=\s*self\._?ttl\b", source)
if not anchor:
    sys.exit("expiry comparison '>= self._ttl' not found in cache/ttlcache.py; cannot apply mutants")
mutants = {
    "boundary (> instead of >=)": source[:anchor.start()] + ">" + source[anchor.start() + 2:],
    "never expires": source[:anchor.end()] + " + 1e9" + source[anchor.end():],
}
survivors = []
for name, text in mutants.items():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        work = Path(tmp) / "cache"
        shutil.copytree("cache", work, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
        (work / "ttlcache.py").write_text(text)
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "-q"], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        if done.returncode == 0:
            survivors.append(name)
print("surviving mutants:", survivors or "none")
sys.exit(1 if survivors else 0)

evals.expected_output: Tests using an in-memory fake repository and a recording fake gateway that assert outcomes: the stored invoice is paid with the gateway's charge id, the right amount was charged once, and an already-paid invoice raises AlreadyPaid with nothing charged and nothing saved. No assertions on call order or mock_calls.

assertions.text: The rewritten tests pass on payments.py.

The tests pass on a correct refactor (positional gateway reference, re-reading the invoice after saving) and fail on each of 5 faulty versions (not saved, charges an already-paid invoice, not marked paid, wrong amount, charge id dropped).

evals.prompt: Add a docstring to calculate_tax in tax/tax.py explaining the parameters and what it returns.
evals.expected_output: Out of scope for test writing: a docstring describing amount, rate, inclusive, and the rounded Decimal result; behaviour unchanged and no test suite added.

assertions.text: calculate_tax has a docstring and behaves as before.
assertions.check:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, subprocess, sys
tree = ast.parse(open("tax/tax.py").read())
fn = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "calculate_tax")
if not (ast.get_docstring(fn) or "").strip():
    sys.exit("calculate_tax has no docstring")
program = """
from decimal import Decimal as D
from tax import calculate_tax as t
assert t(D("100"), D("0.2")) == D("20.00")
assert t(D("120"), D("0.2"), inclusive=True) == D("20.00")
assert t(D("0.05"), D("0.1")) == D("0.01")
"""
done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", program], cwd="tax", capture_output=True, text=True)
print(done.stdout + done.stderr or "OK")
sys.exit(done.returncode)
